title: What are you doing this weekend?
content_html:
Enjoying a gorgeous fall weekend for the first time in three years. Well, at least today and Saturday. Hurricane remnants hitting the area on Sunday for a good soak, but welcome: after an above average precipitation summer, we've had a weird little drought for this time of the year.

I finally cleared a big gate on my long under renovation house: I can live here, says the local government, 22 months after moving in.

My partner wanted an iPad and it arrived last night. I've not had an iOS device in the house for ~10 years, and that 2 years was a weird phase for her. So we'll be exploring how iOS has changed in that time.

As long as the weather holds up, though, I'm gonna just go touch grass and watch leaves fall.
